name: Technical Dependency Impact
description: Assess a pinned project dependency inventory against acquired package, advisory and upstream-change evidence.

parameters.inventory_date: Date of the pinned package-lock.json or requirements.txt

questions: Which dependencies in ${project} at ${inventory_date} match acquired affected ranges?
Which versions are unaffected under assessed ranges, and which remain unknown?
success_criteria: Retain the inventory hash and exact source revision for every cited finding
Keep proposed upgrades separate from executed dependency changes
Label missing advisories or source coverage as unknown
report_outline: Inventory and evidence snapshot for ${project} at ${inventory_date}
